text:
olivia: deploy-bot preflight flagged a regression on the summarizer prompt-eval suite. failure rate ~8% vs baseline ~2% across the sample. change window open until 18:00 UTC. decision needed: pin stable, partial route, or hotpatch? cc @maria @kai

deploy-bot: ```
PREDEPLOY_EVAL REPORT
service: summarizer
candidate: v2.4.1
checks_failed: consistency, rouge_drop
sample_size: 1200
failure_tail: 8%
report: https://releaseboard/reports/5481234567
```

eng-release-qa: quick summary — failures concentrated on finance/legal prompt subset and on long-context cases. a few high-sensitivity hallucinations. attaching 30 random fails to the ticket.

kai: my two cents — prefer staged routing rollback first. set route split 50/50 to fallback v2.3 and canary paused for v2.4.1. if bisect points to tokenizer/quant change we can hotpatch; otherwise keep pinned.

zach: note we have a platform changewindow at 15:00 UTC. rolling forward during the window is risky. i'd rather pin to stable now and schedule hotpatch during next dev window.

maria: product POV — user-facing regressions are unacceptable. approve pin to v2.3. please update release notes and rollback plan. :white_check_mark:

olivia: ok initiating pin now. @deploy-bot please pin summarizer -> v2.3 for release-tag "stable-2026-03-21" and abort canary traffic. reason: preflight eval regression.

deploy-bot: ```bash
# pin command executed by releasebot
deploy pin --service=summarizer --version=v2.3 --scope=org:all --reason="preflight eval regression"
```

deploy-bot: Pin applied. routing: summarizer -> v2.3 (100%). canary paused, rollout aborted. incident note created: REGR-5481.

sre-oncall: acknowledged. i'll monitor latency/error/quality dashboards for the next 30m. will escalate to oncall if any spike >3%.

eng-release-qa: saving failing_examples -> s3://redwood-reports/preflight/5481234567/fails.json and creating ticket REGR-5481 with sample set and quick diffs.

maria: i'll draft release-note blurb: "Pinned summarizer to stable v2.3 due to preflight eval quality regression. Canary paused. Investigation ongoing." will push to release notes and notify support.

olivia: thanks all. follow-ups: @kai take bisect, @zach keep monitoring, @eng-release-qa run deeper evals on the finance/legal subset and share candidate mitigations. I'll close this thread once the post-pin 30m window is clean. :thumbsup:
